svg.title: P009 · Check how Active and Allowed are encoded
svg.desc: One row per source table and distinct raw flag value. Active 1 occurs twice, 0 once and NULL once. COUNT(*) includes the row whose flag is NULL. Start again from Payments. Y appears once and N twice. These three payment rows form two groups. Three Category groups plus two Payments groups give five output rows. Their counts add to seven input rows. The query permits any row order. First branch · FROM Category. Count raw Active values within the category population. Each category contributes once to its own flag group. Second branch · FROM Payments. Payment methods form a separate population. Count Allowed directly in this table so its three rows retain their own frequencies. UNION ALL · append the counts. The question asks for both lists of counts. There is no category-to-payment pair to match. The branches can trade places and return the same five groups. Display order is unspecified.
